title: How Congress Treasonous Act Unlawfully Allowed Washington, D.C. to operate a now defunct Incorporated United States of America
summary: Substack post claiming the 1871 DC Act turned the US into a Crown- and Vatican-controlled corporation with a second constitution.

assertions.quote: As of 1871 the United States isn’t a Country; It’s a Corporation!
The American people do not know that there are two Constitutions in the United States.

verdicts.note: The Constitution has never been replaced; the 1871 Act only organised DC's local government.

assertions.quote: The U.S. has always been and remains a Crown (Roman Catholic Pope) colony.

verdicts.note: Britain recognised US independence in the 1783 Treaty of Paris; no legal authority supports continuing Crown or Vatican control.

assertions.quote: right to travel, which has now been transformed (under corporate government policy) into a “privilege” that requires citizens to be licensed
